$comment: Clio verification profile. Backend commands assume a Postgres on 127.0.0.1:5436 (docker run --name clio-testdb -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=postgres -e POSTGRES_DB=voice_notes_db -p 127.0.0.1:5436:5432 postgres:16) and the env DEBUG=True SECRET_KEY=test DB_HOST=127.0.0.1 DB_PORT=5436 DB_USER=postgres DB_PASSWORD=postgres DB_NAME=voice_notes_db. Frontend browser checks need the dev compose stack on localhost:3011.

voice_notes.name: unit
voice_notes.command: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_tasks.py tests/test_language_detection.py tests/test_cors_preflight.py

voice_notes.name: ui-multilingual
voice_notes.command: cd frontend && npx playwright test e2e/tests/multilingual-upload.spec.js

translations.name: ui-translation
translations.command: cd frontend && npx playwright test e2e/tests/translation.spec.js

full.name: frontend-build
full.command: cd frontend && CI=true npm run build
